analysis.title: US Equities Mid-Day Color
key_insights: Risk-on session at midday on 26 Oct 2026: NDX +102bps, RTY +74bps, SPX +64bps. 292 SPX members higher and 8 of 11 major subsectors in the green. GS desk attributes it to AI stabilizing and Middle East escalation fears being avoided over the weekend.
Last week's outsized moves are reverting higher: AI vs AI at Risk (GSPUARTI) +380bps, Data Centers (GSTMTDAT) +280bps, Semis (GSTMTSEM) +220bps, High Beta Momo (GSPRHIMO) +440bps.
Hedge fund VIP basket (GSPRHVMS) is +63bps. 12M Winners (GSCBHMOM) are +290bps and 12M Losers (GSCBLMOM) are -150bps, so both legs of momentum are moving in the direction of the trend.

Brazil sold off hard: EWZ -22.5%, its worst session outside of Covid (-23%). President Lula won the presidential race despite a first-round deficit, defying prediction market expectations. The desk notes this is only the third presidential election Polymarket has gotten wrong.

Consumer is holding up in a risk-on tape, which the desk says is unusual when the momentum factor outperforms. Restaurants are very strong, reversing Friday's weakness, led by names with recent data concerns (EAT, CMG). The move is broad based.
Liquidity: exchange volumes are +5% vs the 20-day average, while top-of-book liquidity is -12% vs the 20-day average at $8.7mm on the touch.
GS flow: floor is 4 out of 10 and better for sale with a 3% sell skew. The flow theme continues to be tech supply vs consumer demand.

Long-only flows are skewed better for sale on small notional, with supply in info tech, healthcare and industrials against demand in consumer discretionary and communication services. Hedge funds are balanced, tilted very slightly to buy, with demand in macro products, consumer discretionary and healthcare against supply in financials, communication services and energy.

Restaurants rallied strongly, reversing Friday's weakness, led by names that had recent data concerns including EAT.

sector_views.rationale: Consumer is performing well in a risk-on tape, with restaurants leading a broad-based rebound. Hedge funds are buyers and long-only accounts are also buyers of consumer discretionary.
Semis +220bps and Data Centers +280bps on the day, but GS flow shows tech supply from long-only accounts.
Long-only accounts are sellers while hedge funds are buyers, so flow is mixed.

earnings_insights: A GS Greek banks note linked in the document says the desk likes buying the dip in Greek banks (GSXEGRBK) ahead of Q3 earnings on Oct 29 and 30 and Nov 5.
